// Issue #140: Animate Dead returns a Cid that Buried Alive put into the
// graveyard.
//
// Thirteen cards on the play. Five nonlands cannot keep a land out of any
// turn's hand, so the drop is made every turn: Buried Alive's {2}{B} is paid
// on turn 3 whenever it is among the first nine cards, and Animate Dead's
// {1}{B} on turn 4 beside it. Every Cid in the library goes in, and Animate
// Dead brings one back.
8x Swamp [Land]
1x Buried Alive [Tutor]
1x Animate Dead [Reanimation]
3x Cid, Timeless Artificer [Cid]
